title: Spaghetti Carbonara
author: Lorenzo
description: Egg yolks, pecorino, crisp guanciale and plenty of black pepper. No cream.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Crisp the guanciale in a dry pan; take it off the heat.
Whisk the yolks and the whole egg with the pecorino and lots of pepper into a thick cream.
Toss the drained pasta in the pan with the guanciale, then, off the heat, stir in the egg cream with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
